body.message: Aug 11 works perfectly. The security deposit for a 2BR is AED 2,000, fully refundable within 14 working days after check-out. On a 6-month stay, the AED 8,000 rate is locked for the first 3 months, then reviewed against market conditions for the remaining 3, with first and last month required upfront to secure the full period. Want to see it before committing?
